summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests LY5830966, a type II JAK2 inhibitor, in people with myelofibrosis who were previously treated with a type I JAK2 inhibitor. LY5830966 is taken by mouth at several dose levels, and the duration and how often it is taken are not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the drug moves through the body (pharmacokinetics), clinical activity, and changes in biomarkers.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa LY5830966, un inhibidor de JAK2 de tipo II, en personas con mielofibrosis que recibieron antes un inhibidor de JAK2 de tipo I. LY5830966 se toma por vía oral en varios niveles de dosis, y la duración y la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el medicamento se distribuye en el organismo, la actividad clínica y los cambios en los biomarcadores.
who_for: Diagnosis of primary myelofibrosis, post-polycythemia vera myelofibrosis, or post-essential thrombocythemia myelofibrosis.
Previously treated with at least one type I JAK2 inhibitor, with no response or relapse after a response.
Estimated spleen volume of at least 450 cubic centimeters.
Symptom score requirement on the MFSAF form (total symptom score of 10 or more, or at least 2 symptoms scored 3 or more).
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance score of 0 to 3.
not_for: Splenectomy or splenic irradiation within the past 3 months.
Need for a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor as a concomitant medication.
Peripheral neuropathy of grade 2 or higher.
Active, uncontrolled systemic infection or active hepatitis B or C.
Chemotherapy in the previous 4 weeks, or a history of noninfectious pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease.
